task: Assign each story a deterministic hintMode (on/off) and shadow-gate the advisory experience-hints section so reviewers see it only in the ON arm, while hints are still computed and the experience_hint_surfaced event fires (with hintMode) on both arms.
outcome: Running story_review on an ON-arm story includes the 'Project experience hints (advisory only)' section in _reviewPrompt (as today); on an OFF-arm story that section is absent from _reviewPrompt. In BOTH cases, when hints exist, an experience_hint_surfaced event is recorded in the activity log carrying the new hintMode field (on/off) plus the hintIds that were (or would have been) surfaced — so no story loses measurement. The issues/blocker output and any reviewRunId/promptHash are byte-identical regardless of arm.
